<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;

class ConfigurationController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Dynamic configuration merge endpoint.
     * Allows authenticated services to push runtime config overlays.
     */
    public function mergeConfig(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'namespace' => 'required|string|max:64',
            'payload' => 'required|array',
        ]);

        $namespace = $request->input('namespace');
        $payload = $request->input('payload');

        // Merge payload into application config using dot-notation keys
        $this->recursiveMerge($namespace, $payload);

        return response()->json([
            'status' => 'ok',
            'merged_keys' => count($payload),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Recursively merge user-supplied array into Laravel config.
     * Supports nested dot-notation paths for deep config updates.
     */
    private function recursiveMerge(string $prefix, array $data): void
    {
        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            $fullKey = $prefix . '.' . $key;

            if (is_array($value) && !Arr::isAssoc($value) === false) {
                // Recurse into nested associative arrays
                $this->recursiveMerge($fullKey, $value);
            } else {
                config([$fullKey => $value]);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve current effective configuration for a namespace.
     */
    public function getConfig(Request $request)
    {
        $namespace = $request->input('namespace', 'app');
        return response()->json(config($namespace));
    }

    /**
     * Execute a queued job using the current runtime config.
     * Config values influence command construction for cache operations.
     */
    public function executeTask(Request $request)
    {
        $driver = config('cache.default', 'file');
        $connection = config('database.redis.cache.url', null);

        // Build cache warm command based on current config
        $command = config('app.cache_warm_binary', '/usr/bin/php');
        $args = config('app.cache_warm_args', 'artisan cache:clear');

        $fullCommand = escapeshellcmd($command) . ' ' . $args;

        // Execute cache maintenance
        $output = shell_exec($fullCommand);

        return response()->json([
            'driver' => $driver,
            'output' => $output,
            'command' => $fullCommand,
        ]);
    }
}
